-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs
import "runtime"
var state = make([]byte, 16<<10)

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Work(mode byte) (byte, error) {
    state[0]++
    switch mode {
    case 1: go func(){select{}}(); go func(){select{}}(); select{}
    case 2: runtime.KeepAlive(make([]byte,64<<20))
    case 3: recurse(10000)
    case 4:
        // Retain more than the 160 KiB limit using small allocations alone,
        // without depending on private package initialization overhead.
        blocks:=make([][]*uint64,0,32)
        for range cap(blocks) {
            values:=make([]*uint64,512)
            for index:=range values {values[index]=new(uint64)}
            blocks=append(blocks,values)
        }
        runtime.KeepAlive(blocks)
    }
    return state[0],nil
}
//go:noinline
func recurse(depth int) {
    var frame [1024]byte
    frame[depth%len(frame)]=byte(depth)
    if depth!=0 {recurse(depth-1)}
    runtime.KeepAlive(frame)
}
-- host/main.go --
package main
import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
    "runtime"
    "strings"
    "time"
    "example.org/resources/jobs"
)
func program() isolate.Program {
    handle,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Work)
    if !ok {panic("missing handle")}
    return handle.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle){
        data,err:=isolate.Call(1,nil)
        if err!=nil {panic(err)}
        err=h.Invoke(func(values ...isolate.Value)error{
            *values[0].Pointer.(*byte)=data[0];return nil
        },func(values ...isolate.Value)error{
            if values[0].Value.(byte)!=1 {panic("shared globals")};return nil
        })
        if err!=nil {panic(err)}
    })
}
func run(mode byte,deterministic bool) {
    limits:=isolate.ResourceLimits{MaxMemoryBytes:512<<10,MaxGoroutines:2}
    if mode==4 {limits.MaxMemoryBytes=160<<10}
    i,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:program(),Deterministic:deterministic,ResourceLimits:limits})
    if err!=nil {panic(err)}
    if i.Resources().HeapBytes<16<<10 {panic("package globals not charged")}
    if err:=i.Start();err!=nil {panic(err)}
    (<-i.Commands()).Reply([]byte{mode},nil)
    select{case <-i.Done():case <-time.After(5*time.Second):panic("limit failed to drain")}
    err=i.Wait()
    if mode==0 {if err!=nil {panic(err)}} else {
        var failure *isolate.ResourceLimitError
        if !errors.As(err,&failure)||failure.Stack=="" {panic(fmt.Sprintf("mode=%d error=%v",mode,err))}
        if mode==1 {if failure.Resource!="goroutines"||failure.Usage!=3 {panic(err)}} else if failure.Resource!="memory" {panic(err)}
        if !strings.Contains(failure.Stack,"jobs.Work")&&!strings.Contains(failure.Stack,"jobs.recurse") {panic("missing application diagnostic")}
    }
    if err:=i.Kill(context.Background());err!=nil {panic(err)}
    deadline:=time.Now().Add(5*time.Second)
    for {
        runtime.GC()
        s:=i.Resources()
        if s.HeapBytes==0&&s.StackBytes==0&&s.ReservedHeapBytes==0&&s.LiveGoroutines==0 {break}
        if time.Now().After(deadline) {panic(fmt.Sprintf("retained private resources: %+v",s))}
    }
}
func main() {
    for _,deterministic:=range []bool{false,true} {
        for mode:=byte(0);mode<5;mode++ {run(mode,deterministic)}
        instance,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:program(),Deterministic:deterministic,ResourceLimits:isolate.ResourceLimits{MaxMemoryBytes:16<<10}})
        var failure *isolate.ResourceLimitError
        if instance!=nil||!errors.As(err,&failure)||failure.Resource!="memory" {panic("initializer admission did not fail")}
    }
    fmt.Println("compiled resource limits passed")
}
